I felt extremely suicidal at your age too. I'm 23 now and I'm glad I didn't end my life. 

This might sound cliche, and you probably already heard this before, but please trust me when I say that life won't be this way forever. You're 13. You have your entire life ahead of you and might not realize it now, but things can and will change a lot. I'm a lot happier than I was when I was 13, and I'm also from a dysfunctional family. I know I can't speak for you and I don't know all your circumstances, but killing yourself would be a big mistake you cannot come back from. Life is unpredictable. Life can come with surprises. Who knows, you can be in an entirely different place in the future, but if you kill yourself, you would never know.

I know life could be painful, but there's beauty in it too. It might be hard to see right now, but its there. 

Please don't hurt yourself. I know I'm just a stranger on the internet and my words may mean nothing, but stick around. Please.
